show: Commander Cookout Podcast: Magic the Gathering
titel: The Evolution of JUND in Commander - CCO Ep 555

faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (Adresse traegt eine session_id, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Ranking the top Jund commanders from 2019 versus today's MTG meta.
kurzfassung: The hosts break down the arc of evolution by comparing the top 10 Jund commanders from 2019 to the color combination's dominant commanders today. They analyze classic value engines, discuss the impact of Universes Beyond crossovers, and debate how the meta has shifted over the years. Along the way, they share personal deckbuilding stories and promote upcoming community projects.
stichpunkte: Discussing the recent announcement that Wizards of the Coast is reducing annual set releases from 13 to 6
Comparing the top 10 Jund commanders of 2019 with the current EDHREC rankings
Analyzing classic Jund commanders like Kresh the Bloodbraided, Prosh, Skyraider of Kher, and Lord Windgrace
Evaluating the infiltration of Universes Beyond cards into the Jund color combination
Exploring modern staples and high-value commanders such as Henz Toolbox Toray and Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
Highlighting the newly crowned number one Jund permanent, Hearth Hull, the World Seed
Promoting community support projects including the upcoming custom card sleeve and playmat campaign
Sharing updates on upcoming convention appearances in Regina and Vancouver

clips.hook: Remember when Magic was flooded with wordy sets?
clips.text: The speakers look ahead to a future retrospective episode where players will mock the era of oversaturated, overly complex sets and Universes Beyond crossovers.

clips.hook: How high is Lord Windgrace on the all-time list?
clips.text: The hosts debate the exact ranking of a popular planeswalker commander while reviewing historical data.

clips.hook: Prosh was one of the original competitive commanders.
clips.text: The discussion turns to a legendary dragon that once defined high-power tables with its explosive combo potential.
A commander that punishes players for leaving unspent mana in their pool is compared to an old-school rule from early Magic history.

clips.hook: What I hate more than life is having land.
clips.text: A sarcastic remark about sacrificing lands to a spacecraft permanent in order to deal massive damage to opponents.

beschreibung:
The Jund value engines are taking over the Arc of Evolution! 💥

This week Brando and Ryan look back at 2019 to break down the Top 10 Jund Commanders of the past vs. the top color combos dominating the MTG Commander meta today. From classic pre-con favorites like Lord Windgrace to newer powerhouses like Henzie, find out how much Universes Beyond has truly infiltrated the table.
